blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Dark theme with CSS variables and light/dark theming support shows clear design intent, and the multi-panel coordinated layout is well-structured, but the force-directed network is too dense to extract meaning at rendered size and the typographic hierarchy is minimal throughout.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Strong encoding integrity: both node and color-scatter circles correctly use scaleSqrt, the timeline bar chart has a zero baseline (domain [0, maxCount]), all domains are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max, no dual-axis or radius-deception issues; minor deduction for missing key functions on the bar-chart data join and the fgBars updater reusing the full-dataset y-scale on filtered subsets (intentional but undocumented).
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: Correctly implements RAF dirty-flag coalescing for all brush events, no feedback loops (each brush excludes its own layer), no transitions to interrupt, and unified pointer events—only minor concern is synchronous bitmask recomputation (BitFilter.set + filtered()) on every mousemove before the RAF deferred render, which could cause CPU jank on the 24k-block dataset during rapid color/timeline brushing.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: 4-panel crossfilter layout is well-labeled and spatially organized, but the D3 API co-occurrence force network reads as a dense hairball — overlapping edges obscure structure and defeat the panel's analytical purpose; the timeline, color scatter, and thumbnail wall are individually clear.
